body.en: The androecium is made of stamens, each with a filament and an anther. Stamens attached to petals are epipetalous, as in brinjal; attached to the perianth they are epiphyllous, as in lily. Stamens may be free (polyandrous) or united: in one bundle, monoadelphous, as in China rose; in two bundles, diadelphous, as in pea; in more than two bundles, polyadelphous, as in Citrus.
body.kn: ಪುಂಕೇಸರಗಳು ದಳಕ್ಕೆ ಅಂಟಿದರೆ ದಳಾಸಕ್ತ (ಬದನೆ), ಪುಷ್ಪಪತ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಅಂಟಿದರೆ ಪರಿದಳಾಸಕ್ತ (ಲಿಲಿ). ಒಂದು ಕಟ್ಟು: ದಾಸವಾಳ; ಎರಡು ಕಟ್ಟು: ಬಟಾಣಿ; ಹಲವು ಕಟ್ಟು: ನಿಂಬೆ.

Stamens attached to petals are epipetalous, as in brinjal; attached to the perianth they are epiphyllous, as in lily. Stamens may be free (polyandrous) or united: in one bundle, monoadelphous, as in China rose; in two bundles, diadelphous, as in pea; in more than two bundles, polyadelphous, as in Citrus.

body.en: The gynoecium is made of one or more carpels, each with a stigma, style and ovary. If the carpels are free it is apocarpous, as in lotus and rose; if fused, syncarpous, as in mustard and tomato. After fertilisation the ovules become seeds and the ovary becomes the fruit.
body.kn: ಶಲಾಕೆಗಳು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ ವಿಯುಕ್ತ ಶಲಾಕಾ (ಕಮಲ, ಗುಲಾಬಿ); ಕೂಡಿದ್ದರೆ ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಶಲಾಕಾ (ಸಾಸಿವೆ, ಟೊಮೆಟೊ). ಫಲೀಕರಣದ ನಂತರ ಅಂಡಕ ಬೀಜವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಅಂಡಾಶಯ ಹಣ್ಣಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: The gynoecium is made of one or more carpels, each with a stigma, style and ovary. If the carpels are free it is apocarpous, as in lotus and rose; if fused, syncarpous, as in mustard and tomato. After fertilisation the ovules become seeds and the ovary becomes the fruit.
narration.kn: ಶಲಾಕೆಗಳು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ ವಿಯುಕ್ತ ಶಲಾಕಾ (ಕಮಲ, ಗುಲಾಬಿ); ಕೂಡಿದ್ದರೆ ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಶಲಾಕಾ (ಸಾಸಿವೆ, ಟೊಮೆಟೊ). ಫಲೀಕರಣದ ನಂತರ ಅಂಡಕ ಬೀಜವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಅಂಡಾಶಯ ಹಣ್ಣಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Placentation is the arrangement of ovules in the ovary. Marginal: the placenta forms a ridge along the ventral suture of a one-chambered ovary, as in pea. Axile: ovules are attached to a central placenta in a multi-chambered ovary, as in China rose, tomato and lemon. Parietal: ovules develop on the inner wall of the ovary, which becomes two-chambered by a false septum, as in mustard and Argemone. Free central: ovules are borne on a central axis with no septa, as in Dianthus and Primrose. Basal: a single ovule is attached at the base of the ovary, as in sunflower and marigold.
body.kn: ಜರಾಯು ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ: ಅಂಚಿನ (ಬಟಾಣಿ), ಅಕ್ಷೀಯ (ದಾಸವಾಳ, ಟೊಮೆಟೊ, ನಿಂಬೆ), ಭಿತ್ತಿಯ (ಸಾಸಿವೆ, ಆರ್ಜಿಮೋನ್), ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಕೇಂದ್ರೀಯ (ಡಯಾಂಥಸ್, ಪ್ರಿಮ್‌ರೋಸ್), ತಳದ (ಸೂರ್ಯಕಾಂತಿ, ಚೆಂಡುಹೂ).

problem.en: A cross-section of an ovary shows three chambers with the ovules attached to the central column where the septa meet. Name the placentation and give two examples.

steps.en: Ovules attached to a central placenta where the septa meet is axile placentation.
Examples: China rose, tomato or lemon.

answer.en: Axile placentation, e.g. tomato and lemon

narration.en: Let us work through this together. A cross-section of an ovary shows three chambers with the ovules attached to the central column where the septa meet. Name the placentation and give two examples.

body.en: Pea pod – marginal; tomato or lemon – axile; mustard – parietal; Dianthus – free central; sunflower seed – basal.

narration.en: Five placentations, five kitchen examples. Pea pod – marginal; tomato or lemon – axile; mustard – parietal; Dianthus – free central; sunflower seed – basal.
